purpose: This table provides cleaned, hourly weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in 2013, feeding downstream flight-delay and operations analyses that join on airport and hour.
usage: Consumers should join on origin and time_hour as the declared grain, cast numeric fields are ready for aggregation, and must handle nulls explicitly in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure since these are retained as nullable rather than imputed.
limitations: wind_gust is missing in 74.6% of rows and pressure in 11.5%, so any analysis relying on these fields will have reduced coverage; wind_dir and wind_speed have small null rates (1.7% and 0.02% respectively) that still require null-aware logic; no duplicate rows were found so no dedupe logic was applied.
